title: Webinar plan
description: Plan a webinar or online event: topic, speakers, promotion, registration and consent, accessibility and follow-up.

inputs.label: Topic and the audience problem it addresses
Speakers and their consent to being recorded
Registration fields and the tool that stores them

tool_actions.description: Sending invitations, reminders and the replay.

sections.title: Agenda
sections.prompt: The sequence of the session, who speaks when, and the time kept for questions.

sections.title: Promotion
sections.prompt: The channels and dates that bring registrations, with tagged links. Build each tagged link with openguildkit deliverable utm.

sections.title: Registration and consent
sections.prompt: The fields collected, their legal basis, the recording notice and what registrants receive.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.prompt: Captions, slides shared beforehand and a way to ask questions without speaking.

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.prompt: The replay, answers to open questions, and what sales does with attendees who agreed to be contacted.

checks.verification: The speakers rehearsed on the platform with the final slides.
The registration consent and the recording notice are confirmed by the data protection owner.
Captions were tested for the live session or the replay.
